intent: To illustrate the surge in imported COVID-19 cases in Taiwan during March 2020, which occurred while local community spread remained low, thereby explaining the need for new strategies.

requirements.question: Must the video show the rising imported trend across multiple March dates?
Must the video state or show that local cases remained low?
Must the video directly compare imported and local counts in late March?

units.claim: Imported cases rose sharply across March, from low single digits to late-March peaks in the 20s.
accept: Imported cases jumped from 2 in late Feb to 29 by late March.
March imported cases climbed from single digits to 20s.
Imported bar heights rise sharply across March 2020.
Imported cases surged to peaks of 27 and 29 in late March.
units.evidence: Imported bars visibly grow from low early values to 27 and 29 in late March.

units.claim: Local community cases remained low throughout, with the highest local bar only 8.
accept: Local cases stayed low, peaking at only 8.
Community spread remained low, with local bars mostly 1 to 3.
The tallest local bar reaches just 8.
Local case counts remain small while imported counts rise.
units.evidence: Local bars stay low and never exceed height 8 on the chart.

units.claim: In the 25 Mar section, imported cases far outnumbered local cases: 72 imported vs 11 local.
accept: In the 25 Mar section, imported cases were 72 vs 11 local.
Late-March imported cases outnumbered local about 6.5 to 1.
Imported bars dwarf local bars in the 25 Mar section.
25 Mar section shows 72 imported and 11 local cases.
units.evidence: In the 25 Mar section, imported bars are much taller than the local bars.

optional_valid: Mention specific date labels such as 17 Mar 20 and 25 Mar 20.
Show the local peak of 8 on 25 Mar 20.
Highlight imported peak of 29 on 25 Mar 20.
Use color legend distinguishing Local from Imported.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all role=bar data rows; annotation rows excluded

clip_hardcase.reason: The reference SVG has no explicit data-role=bar mark, so visual-unit reconstruction needs manual review.

hardcases.handling: Requires human visual inspection before semantic scoring.
